newsitem.title: USA: Koch high bidder for posted basis Elk Hills crude.
newsitem.headline: Koch high bidder for posted basis Elk Hills crude.

text.p: Koch Oil Co was the highest bidder in the U.S. government's offering of 29,300 barrels per day of crude oil (bpd) from the Elk Hills Naval Petroleum Reserve in Bakersfield, the U.S. Department of Energy said.
On a posted price index, the company bid $20.2319 for 4,057 bpd of crude from the 18G zone. Bids were for a six-month delivery period starting April 1.
Texaco Refining was the higher bidder for 8,001 bpd of crude from the 10G zone. The refiner bid $17.8520 .
On a West Texas Intermediate Index, EOTT Energy was the highest bidder at $24.83 for 1,001 bpd of crude from the 18G zone. Bids were for a two-month period starting April 1.
